en.title: Global hearing accessibility standards advance as IAHA launches international working group
en.summary: The International Association of Hearing Aid Professionals (IAHA) has formed a global working group to develop and promote hearing accessibility standards. This initiative aims to improve access for people with hearing disabilities worldwide. Additionally, Amtrak announced nationwide station and train upgrades, while accessiBe reported that 78% of ecommerce content is AI-generated and largely unchecked for accessibility.

zh-TW.title: IAHA成立全球工作小組推進聽力無障礙標準
zh-TW.summary: 國際助聽器專業協會（IAHA）成立全球工作小組，致力於推進聽力無障礙標準的制定與推廣。此外，Levitt AMP 哈里森堡音樂系列新增無障礙設備，以提升殘障觀眾體驗。accessiBe 研究顯示 78% 電子商務內容為 AI 生成，幾乎未經無障礙檢查。
